_about: The shot list, kept beside build-guides.py. shotsDir is resolved against THIS file's folder, never the current directory. build is the stamp shown in the app when the captures were taken; inventory --build <stamp> fails when it differs. Each guide under required lists roles x screens, plus pairs for a screen only some of its roles see. doc_kit.py inventory <this file> [--guide user] [--figures ../out/*.figures.json] fails on a missing file, a required (screen, role) with no shot, and a figure a build used that is not listed here. Capture in the PUBLISHED app as each role, with test data only. File names: <screen>-<role>[-<state>].png, lower case; email-<message>-<role>.png for a message (copied as taken by trim).
build: <build stamp the captures were taken on>
